### Phase 8.4: finalist-only entropy and shared token tape

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase8-4-finalist-token-tape/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Confine entropy alternatives to one or two finalists and share a typed per-section token tape between training and exact Count/Store. Compare Store-every-finalist with Count-then-Store-one; require a 3% end-to-end win before changing policy.

### Phase 8.5: profile-guided leaf and build optimization

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase8-5-leaf-finishing/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`
